summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Entra SSO scaffolding (graceful-disable) and Multi-Part freight panel regression after the calcShipment rewrite. All 8 backend pytest cases PASSED (auth/config, Entra-503, admin login, bad creds, schema with empty password_hash, SSO_REQUIRED guard, MP engine regression). All 3 frontend flows PASSED: login page renders correctly with Entra button hidden + correct footer, password login → SPOT app → logout works, and the high-risk freight-panel Ship+90210 flow produced the exact expected toast and a reasonable per-component allocation.
action_items: None blocking. Entra SSO scaffolding is verified — once Microsoft credentials land in /app/backend/.env (ENTRA_TENANT_ID/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET), /api/auth/entra/login should flip from 503 to a 302 to login.microsoftonline.com and /api/auth/config will return sso_enabled=true; UI will auto-show the entra-sso-btn. No further changes needed in the SPOT app.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth_entra.py is well-structured. Minor: `_STATE_SECRET` falls back to JWT_SECRET — when running multi-pod prod, ensure SSO_STATE_SECRET is explicitly set so state cookies survive a JWT_SECRET rotation.

auth_entra.entra_callback short-circuits with 503 BEFORE the state-cookie check when SSO is unconfigured. This means the test 'callback without cookie returns 400' is technically only true once Entra env vars are set. Documented this in test_entra_callback_503_when_unconfigured (accepts 400 OR 503 to be future-proof).

frontend/src/lib/shipment.js — new verbatim port of legacy calcShipment. Verified live: combined-shipment freight produced 954 lbs total / 4 skids / $616.92 LTL @ 90210, identical legacy parity expected. No regressions.

RightDashboard FreightPanel correctly allocates per-component freight by weight — $616.92 total ÷ 3 components produced item-1 base of $56.91 (item 1 is the smallest of the three by weight), totals exactly to the combined LTL quote. Behavior matches the legacy SPOT tool.
test_credentials: admin@standardprinting.com / spot-admin-2026 — verified working via password flow. No Entra credentials needed in this iteration.
seed_data_creation: None — used the existing admin seed (idempotent /api/auth/seed-admin on app boot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Entra SSO is fully scaffolded but env-gated. When the user provides ENTRA_TENANT_ID/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET, run these new checks: (1) /api/auth/config → sso_enabled=true; (2) GET /api/auth/entra/login → 302 to login.microsoftonline.com with state cookie set; (3) GET /api/auth/entra/callback (no cookie) → 400 'Missing or expired SSO state cookie' (NOT 503); (4) flip SSO_REQUIRED=true → /api/auth/login returns 403 'Password login is disabled' (the route already has this guard, currently only inert because env=false). For freight: the legacy parity port in /app/frontend/src/lib/shipment.js is now live and emitting correct combined-shipment LTL quotes (verified destZip=90210 → OLD DOMINION 4 skids 954 lbs $616.92). Toast format: 'Per-Item Freight $X via [Carrier] · N skids · M lbs combined'.
rca_of_the_issue: No regression detected. Both this session's P0 changes (Auto-Route resolver fix + combined-shipment freight weight) are wired correctly. Backend Entra scaffolding gracefully returns 503 when env vars are blank and the UI hides the Microsoft button accordingly. Multi-Part freight produces a single combined LTL quote ($616.92, 954 lbs, 4 skids) and allocates per-component by weight — matches legacy SPOT behavior.
